errors.evidence: The description claims that there are percentage labels inside each sector, but the chart only shows labels for two out of the four sectors: "Столица" (81.8%) and "Областен град" (9.1%). The "Друг град" and "Село" sectors do not have percentage labels.

The description omits the total number of responses (22), which is stated below the title as "22 отговора". This information is crucial for understanding the context and sample size of the survey data presented.
